***First time participants***
Step 1 - Sign-up

Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned)
Step 3 - Pay using the link on Cubelelo website

Registrations will be confirmed within 48 hours of making the payment according to the above guidelines. 

*Last date for registration & payment* - June 29, 2017

Leave a WhatsApp message on +91 9052529279 if you have additional queries.
